results.title: Modern Data Architecture in the Cloud: Transforming ...
results.content: By leveraging the flexibility, scalability, and managed services offered by cloud-based NoSQL databases, organizations can build agile and cost-effective data architectures that support a wide range of modern data applications and use cases in the cloud. Machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) integration are essential components of modern data architecture in the cloud, enabling organizations to extract valuable insights, automate processes, and make data-driven decisions. Cloud computing platforms provide scalable storage, compute, and analytics services that enable organizations to process large volumes of data efficiently and dynamically scale resources based on demand. Cloud-based stream processing services, such as AWS Kinesis, Google Cloud Dataflow, and Azure Stream Analytics, enable organizations to process and analyze real-time data streams at scale, providing low-latency insights and enabling real-time decision-making. Stream processing platforms like Apache Kafka provide the foundation for implementing event sourcing and CQRS patterns in cloud-based architectures, enabling organizations to build scalable, event-driven systems that handle both real-time and historical data processing workloads.
